name: I o Shiranai Heroine e
original_name: Iを知らないヒロインへ
source:
"What is love?"

"Aono Ruka" received a love letter with an unknown sender.

She gets her childhood friend, "Ichinose Kuroto," to help her find out the true meaning of the letter.

This is the story of a heroine who doesn't know who loves her.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6609]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“什么是爱？”

“青野流花”收到了一封寄信人不明的情书。

她请儿时好友“一之濑黑人”帮助她找出这封信的真正含义。

这是一个女主角不知道谁爱她的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6609]NovelGame[/url]]
